-2.help: Use rli2 mode - all files must be sorted. Low mem usage.

-T.help: Directory to store temp files in

-b.help: Use binary search vs hash (slower, but less memory)

-c.help: Output lines common to input and remove files

-d.help: Removes duplicate lines from input (on by default)

-f.help: Use files instead of memory (slower, but small memory)

-i.help: Ignore any error/missing files on remove list

-l.help: Limit all matching to a specific length.

-n.help: Do not remove duplicate lines from input

-q.help: a - all output, c - count, l - length, w - word, s - running statistics, h - append histogram Additional files will be matched against input files

-s.help: Sort output. Default is input order. This will make the -b and -f options substantially faster
